title: Flooring Ideas for Contemporary Living Rooms: Transform Your Space
htmlContent:
The first priority for a new modern living room is choosing the perfect flooring. It‘s the first thing to consider in turning your house into a contemporary retreat. In this article, we look at plenty of flooring ideas for your modern living room.

Understanding Flooring Options for Living Rooms

 

Importance of Choosing the Right Flooring

The floor of your living room is one of the most important elements when it comes to the look and feel of your living room.  It influences the style and setting of the whole room,  from the furniture arrangement to the throw pillow choices, so there are many design decisions involved in choosing the perfect living room flooring. The right living room flooring can add the right personality and style for your family and will enable your living room to be the warm hearth you would like it to be.

Overview of Living Room Flooring Materials

The most common materials used in a living room floor include,  but are not limited to; Wooden flooring (hardwood or engineered),  Tile flooring (ceramic, porcelain or vitrified tiles) and more recent manufactured solutions such as luxury vinyl flooring, laminate flooring and even a polished concrete flooring option. As there are so many options available, there are many different styles, textures and finishes to choose from so one of them should match your needs and style preferences.

High-Traffic Areas and Durability Considerations

When it comes to selecting flooring for your living rooms,  durability is such an important consideration in this high traffic room. Opting for material that is resilient to the daily effects of life living in an active space and looks good while doing that. The most suitable living room flooring options include vitrified tiles, laminate flooring and luxury vinyl flooring, all of which represent hardwearing materials that cope well to scratches and spills. Natural stone flooring such as marble or granite is known for its longevity and aesthetic,  although these might need extra maintenance.

Tile Flooring Designs for Modern Living Rooms

 

Benefits of Using Floor Tiles

Floor tiles are also an excellent flooring material for any modern living room setting. Many types of floor tiles are available as alternatives for the modern living room interior design, from the elegant glossy finishes,  to the rough textured ones. The vast variety of designs allow many choices of the finished look, and the durable nature of tiles makes the floor tiles a practical solution for busy lifestyles in the modern era. The ease of maintenance of the tiles also add to this positive feature of contemporary floor tiles.

Exploring Different Tile Designs

One of the most appealing reasons for using floor tile for your living rooms is the great variety of tile designs available.  Whatever type of floor looks you might have,  one of the many different kinds of tile flooring will offer a pattern,  a color,  a texture, or a combination to what you want.  Large format tiles are used in many current flooring trends, as they give the impression of more space, while more decorated designs can lend some color and style to your room. From the more sophisticated look of vitrified tiles to the classic beauty of wood-look ceramic floors, your living room flooring ideas can be implemented in many different design combinations.

Marble and Granite Floor Tiles

Marble and granite floor tiles are the epitome of eternal class and can bring an eminent chic to any contemporary lounge. Marble flooring,  which has a characteristic veining and a reflectively shiny surface lends a luxurious and resoundingly elegant aura to the living room. Granite flooring,  famous for the scratch resistant durability it offers makes for a tough yet stunning floor.  Marble and granite flooring are altogether a natural and luxurious addition to the living room and focus on one thing: class. If you are looking to make a sensible investment in your flooring material then investing in marble or granite flooring would be an inexhaustible inspiration to your living room wear.

Wooden Flooring Choices for a Contemporary Look

 

Advantages of Wood Flooring

A popular choice, easy to find and highly desirable, if you can‘t afford the real wood flooring then a great compromise is the laminated wood flooring which has many of the appealing qualities of true wooden flooring. This is one of those varieties that can massively enhance your interior design and home decor through the many different styles on offer. Living room flooring choices can be enduring classics such as wooden flooring with its natural beauty, easy to maintain surface and long lasting materials. This type of flooring offers a warm and natural atmosphere from your living room you will never want to leave.

Wooden Floor Tiles vs. Traditional Wood Planks

A main consideration when buying wooden floors in the living rooms is whether to choose these wooden floor tiles or the traditional wooden planks of wood flooring. This can depend on the type of room in the house. The more traditional wood planks of wood flooring provide a classic look, a very elegant classic wood flooring look,  which is very trendy and sought after. The wooden floor tiles are made of ceramic or some other material but then covered with a wood facing,  so as they are designed to mimic a wooden floor in terms of their look. These tiles can be made in the same color palette as real wood and can be arranged in any pattern, they fit both modern and classic designs.

Rustic vs. Modern Wood Designs

The flooring of wood can be rustic or very modern,  adaptable to any format of living room.  Modern wood designs tend to have smooth,  flat surfaces with fewer seams (usually with wider widths). The stains are usually lighter or darker, and are quite uniform that is,  they do not have much varied coloration. Rustic wood designs are often distressed, with obvious grain lines,  and maybe the occasional knot of hidden grain. They all create a versatile living room that is either elegant or cozy,  according to your preference.

Carpet Flooring in Contemporary Living Rooms

 

Benefits of Carpet Flooring

Charpeting has its own advantages and it is a good example of a good modern living room carpet that provides comfort and warmth.  Carpet flooring is very soft so that it gives an enormous feeling under foot,  obviously creating a sense of welcoming atmosphere in your living space.  Carpet has a big reputation for absorbing sound and offers increased privacy in a living area for not only luxurious but busy living.  Carpet also has many durable and stain resistant fibres as developments in manufacturing have been made in the current age.

Choosing the Right Carpet for Your Living Room Style

If you are considering carpeting for your living room there are a few things you need to think about when choosing the right carpet flooring to suit the style of your living room.  Nowadays living rooms can look very elegant and chic, so neutral shades and subtle patterns for carpets are perfect for a chic modern look that will work with your living room furniture and accessories.  You might also want to think about the texture or pile height for example for a modern design you can opt for a low pile,  close woven carpet for a sleek and stylish look. Alternatively for a cozy living room you might want to go for a deeply plush high pile to snuggle up on. Remember also to consider the traffic to your living room- the more traffic- the more durable and stain resistant the fibers need to be to keep your carpet flooring in perfect condition that works with your flooring ideas.

Care and Maintenance Tips for Carpet Flooring

If the carpet flooring in this living room is to retain its visual appeal and durability than this needs to be constantly cared for. Carpet flooring in this living room needs to be vacuumed regularly throughout (particularly in more trafficked areas) so that it does not trap dirt and dust into the pile.  Any spills or stains must be cleaned up immediately to ensure they do not mark the pile;  always dab,  rather than rub, with a clean cloth and the correct solution or carpet cleaner.  It is recommended that every 12-18 months the carpet flooring is professionally shampooed and cleaned. If the carpet is to be professionally cleaned (this can be done more regularly) it will retain its appearance for a lot longer and require less maintenance in the long term.

Concrete Floors: A Modern and Durable Option

 

Designing with Concrete Flooring

Concrete flooring ideas are becoming more frequent and give you a modern look to your floor for all modern homes and living rooms.  Great for creating a minimal look to your living room,  concrete flooring ideas can work with any style, to give you a sleek,  stylish look which will be sure to look stunning.  Giving fantastic in built character and style, the concrete floor will give you an incredibly hard working, durable,  base to your living room interior but at the same time giving it a unique look to match you. The amazing part of the concrete flooring ideas is how adaptable it is,  to give you different colors and finishes to suit your estate furniture and house accessories.

Stylish Finishes for Concrete Floors

The best part about concrete flooring is that there are so many fashionable finishes on offer to allow you to completely personalise your living room flooring. This can range from a high gloss, mirror finish which reflects light and makes a room feel bigger;  to a less reflective matt finish with textured coating which lends a more understated,  rustic feel to the room.  A range of stains and dyes are available to add bright colors into the concrete and by contrasting the grinding which exposes aggregates and adds visual interest to your living room floor,  concrete is an attractive and lasting choice.

Concrete in High-Traffic Living Spaces

As a rugged and highly durable flooring material,  concrete is obviously one of the best choices for transit areas of your living rooms. It can benefit from its unique durability and hardness, stand up to the maelstrom of life live in your living rooms.  Besides, concrete floor surfaces are relatively simple to keep clean as well. If you‘re looking for a flooring that is attractive and functional with long-lasting modern feeling in busy living rooms, concrete would be the best living room flooring solution.

Final Thoughts on Living Room Flooring Ideas

 

Combining Different Flooring Types

One of the most unique living room flooring ideas for modern interiors is the idea of mixing and matching different types of flooring to create zones as well as to add visual appeal and charm. For example,  you could have plush carpet flooring placed in a particular area with cozy seating arrangements, in a huge living room with modern tile flooring or contemporary wooden floors.  Similarly, you could even add an area of luxury vinyl flooring with an area of concrete floor to make the floors more interesting and visually appealing, adding a unique dimension to your living room interior.

Creating a Cohesive Look in Your Living Room

In order to bring together the look of your living room with more than one type of flooring, it is also most important to do it in style. This means you need to ensure the two flooring styles go beautifully together.  You should look to match the colors,  textures and styles and ensure you match your style to your existing home decor and interior design. For instance, if you are installing wooden flooring you should try to find a shade of wood to match that of the wooden floor or tiles you are installing next to your carpet.

Future Trends in Living Room Flooring

The future of our living rooms’ floors is going to be eco friendly,  hi-tech and having amazing new concepts of floors. We expect a growing trend toward environmentally friendly materials such as reclaimed wood flooring and recycled content in luxury vinyl flooring and laminate flooring.  The growth of “Smart” flooring that uses sensors for heating and lighting controls are believed to be widely adopted in the recent future. Customization of design is also predicted to be wide spread, for example personalized tile designs, distinctive plank patterns and custom finishes.
